about: LAYERS stack v7 live explode (three.js). o_j(t) = ease(clamp((t - t0[j]) / dur[j], 0, 1)) for j = 0..3 (AUDIT..RUN), ease = smootherstep u^3(6u^2-15u+10); close (scroll-forward only, camera already in the attention scene): o_j *= 1 - ease((t - close_t0 - (3-j)*0.25)/close_dur). Scrolling back reverses exactly (pure function of t). Blender Z-up world metres; *_threejs = (x, z, -y). Rest = the closed stack exactly as modelled (all nodes identity at rest). Live extras: glaze pulse travels up LAYERS_spine (existing LAYERS_pulse*/courier* animation, recentred on the new spine via delta_location); LAYERS_rotor_* spin about their local Z (0.6 rad/s, alternate direction). LAYERS_trayfill_* (children of the lid nodes) = soft RectAreaLights, intensity w_open * o_k(t).

trayfill.note: area light under each lid half, energy * o_k (live: RectAreaLight intensity * o_k); v6: 260->150 W and a more neutral colour so the terracotta keeps the ref darkness (no flat/pink)

nodes.scale_z: (rest_length + cap_dz) / rest_length about the base (telescoping; base + axis fixed; cap_dz = the LAYERS_cap_pivot dz)

scene_rules.about: v6 COPY-AREA rule (director option (a)): during the LAYERS beat the right ~45% of the hold frame must be clean sand + sky. w(t) = ease(clamp((t - fade_out[0]) / (fade_out[1] - fade_out[0]), 0, 1)) * (1 - ease(clamp((t - fade_in[0]) / (fade_in[1] - fade_in[0]), 0, 1))), ease = smootherstep. w = 0 outside 16.5..31 s (scene exactly as baked), 1 from 18.0 to 29.0 s. Pure function of t (scrubbing back reverses). Applied as-is in the Blender preview (stack_preview_v6.py).

rules.target: collection ATTN (every mesh: spheres/cup/petals ATTN_p*, threads ATTN_th*, rods ATTN_dk*, feed ATTN_feed + ATTN_feed_tok*, tiles ATTN_tile*, tokens ATTN_tok*, tablets, planes, coil, core)
rules.threejs: material.transparent = true; material.opacity = 1 - w; depthWrite = (w < 0.5); object.visible = (w < 0.999); castShadow off while w > 0

rules.target: ground_attn + ground_loss faces with material 'ground' (dark attention pad + loss-basin clay patches)
rules.threejs: ground shader: albedo = mix(sandAlbedo, clayAlbedo, clayMask * uLayersClay), uLayersClay = 1 - w (the baked ground already lerps sand->clay by this mask, so w = 1 gives plain sand; no fog-colour push, which reads as a bright salt flat)

rules.value: z_blender' = z * (1 - 0.8 * w)  (three.js: position.y *= 1 - 0.8 w in the vertex shader, uniform uLayersRaise)
rules.note: flattens the basin rim/bowl toward the plain so its silhouette and shadowed slope vanish at the horizon

scene_rules.about_v8: v8: fade_in_ground [33.5, 35.5] = a later fade-in used ONLY for the clay/crack weight of ground_loss (the loss basin): w_ground(t) = same formula with fade_in_ground instead of fade_in. ATTN opacity, the attention-pad clay (ground_attn) and the basin raise keep fade_in 29-31 (a late raise leaves a visible seam at the basin edge). So the v8 exit, which sees the basin edge 29.5-33.5 s, never shows the clay bowl as a dark blotch; the basin is out of frame from ~34 s and fully restored by 35.5 (attn t33/t36 three.js frames pixel-identical to before).

layers.note: per-scene fog for the LAYERS beat (19.5-30 s): the stack (22-38 m from the camera) stays essentially unfogged; the far plain (loss basin, attention cluster at 45-65 m) fades 25-75%. Blend to the global animatic fog (8..63 m) over 31-36 s (exit).
